about.description: Arcus perpetual market tracking Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN) with 24/7 exposure to the underlying mega-cap e-commerce & cloud stock. Total-return tracking (dividends, splits, and futures rolls passed through funding), cash-settled in USDG on the Arcus off-chain CLOB with permissioned appchain re-verification and EVM rootchain custody.
